description_en: Switches the primary and secondary nodes of a MongoDB instance
description_zh: 切换MongoDB实例中的主备节点
name: SwitchDBInstanceHA

parameters.help_en:
Instance ID of the shard node in a sharded cluster instance.

If the DBInstanceId parameter is set to instance ID of a sharded cluster instance, this parameter is required
parameters.help_zh:
分片集群实例中Shard节点的ID。

当DBInstanceId参数传入的是分片集群实例ID时，本参数必须传入
parameters.name: node_id

parameters.help_en:
The IDs of the roles for which you want to perform a switchover. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/123802.html operation to query instance IDs and node role information.

Separate multiple instance IDs with commas (,). If this parameter is not specified, the primary and secondary nodes are switched.
If the DBInstanceId parameter is set to the ID of a sharded cluster instance, the roles for which the switchover is performed must belong to the same shard node
parameters.help_zh:
需要执行切换的角色ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/123802.html接口获取角色ID和节点角色信息。

角色ID以英文逗号（,）分隔，不传入本参数则切换主备节点。
当DBInstanceId参数传入的是分片集群实例ID时，执行切换的角色必须属于同一Shard节点中
parameters.name: role_ids

parameters.help_en:
The time when the primary and secondary nodes are switched. Valid values:
0: switches the nodes immediately.
1: switches the nodes within the maintenance window
parameters.help_zh:
切换主备节点的时间点。取值：
0：立即切换。
1：在可运维时间段内切换
parameters.name: switch_mode

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request and prevent duplicate submissions. The value is generated by the client and must be unique across different requests. The value can be up to 64 ASCII characters in length and cannot contain non-ASCII characters
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过 64 个 ASCII 字符，且该参数值中不能包含非 ASCII 字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run on the request. Valid values:
true: performs a dry run without calling the operation. The system checks the request parameters, request format, business limits, and inventory. If the check fails, an error is returned. If the check succeeds, the DryRunOperation error code is returned.
false: sends a normal request and performs the operation after the check succeeds. This is the default value
parameters.help_zh:
是否对本次请求执行预检查，取值：
true：执行预检查，不真正调用该接口。检查项包含请求参数、请求格式、业务限制和库存等。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误；如果检查通过，则返回错误码 DryRunOperation。
false（默认）：发送正常请求，通过检查后直接执行本次操作
parameters.name: dry_run
